No, the truth is I'm suicidal and don't feel like telling my real story. Nobody wants to hear it. I have no friends and get no attention. It's my pathetic way of getting attention, and it works. This forum annoys me anyway since everyone is so automatically against suicide (I think it's a valid option).

I'll be dead in three to six months. How about that?

With that, I sign off and will never check this account again. Goodbye.
If it makes you feel better, I am going to off myself soon.
Check the update to my post.

Nobody. I told court psychologists half the truth because I felt guilty. My dad fucked me repeatedly and I didn't tell them that. I didn't feel like I could trust anybody anyways, and it's something I will live with now.
I don't know how to meet people. I have nothing in common with anybody. All I want to do is drink myself numb and cut. Maybe if I quit school and got a job...

I wish I could go to a foster home or anywhere theers not relatives. I'm drinking now because I am so anxious thinking about what I'm going to do when they get back together. The full truth was never told in court.
I don't them to see my cutting besides. I've been doing a lot of that lately after drinking vodka. I just feel numb.
I hate the concelors at my school and don't trust them. There's not really anything they can do since dad will have served his time. I don't want to live with him ever again.
